Claude-motion is a JavaScript toolkit that empowers coding agents to create sophisticated motion graphics and web-based simulations. It provides agents with 'taste' by teaching them motion design principles, enabling self-review of frames, and integrating a sound engine for audio generation. The toolkit also facilitates the conversion of web simulations into high-frame-rate videos.
